verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a `local-ai chat` command, documented as "an agent in your shell" that answers questions, reads files and runs commands behind an approval gate. That directly covers starting an interactive chat with a model from the terminal. The evidence is short feature mentions rather than in-depth CLI documentation; missing for 10: detailed docs on selecting or specifying a model for the chat session and on session controls such as flags or history, plus independent hands-on corroboration.
